headline: Gulf South wins as often as it loses
dek: AUM, Trevecca and UAH have won every match they have played, and Christian Brothers and Union have lost every one of theirs. Only Delta State have done both, winning at Harding and losing at Central Baptist, while Mississippi Christian, Montevallo and West Alabama have drawn but not yet won.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is not one striker's doing: UAH's eight goals have come from seven different players.

wire.line: UAH have scored more goals than Christian Brothers, Delta State, Union, Lee and Spring Hill have between them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lee and Spring Hill have yet to play: no win, no draw, no loss, and no goal at either end.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: The record's silences are all of one kind: five matches have passed their date with no result at all, and no final has been left without a score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mississippi Christian have two matches on the record and no box score for either: the results are published, the detail behind them is not.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Christian Brothers have conceded seven goals, more than any other programme has let in.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jakob Buhrkuhl has made seven saves for AUM and conceded one goal.

last_match.line: West Alabama's first defeat, and the first match in which they have not scored.

next_match.line: Delta State have yet to play at home; Ouachita Baptist have already beaten a Gulf South side.

table_state.statement: The table is empty because no result yet counts toward it; the conference's own season opens on September 11.
table_state.footnote: The form column carries results from matches that fall outside the table, and none of them has been counted into it.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
